bubbles.title: Pick a parser
bubbles.hint: Decision: node:util parseArgs, strict mode, options table (no tokens wrapper) — goal is readable code. Words starting with - need -- (hint 2 -- use -v flag). mri: no strict; commander: fights the bubble grammar
